title: Why is Life the Way it Is? with Nick Lane
summary: Nick Lane's Royal Institution lecture on the origin of life and why it is the way it is. It draws on his book The Vital Question and the alkaline hydrothermal vent theory of abiogenesis.
why: HN points to it as an accessible presentation of Lane's ideas on life's origins and the rarity of complex life.

quote.text: There is also his "Why is Life the Way it Is?" talk he held last year at the Royal Institution.
